attBesluta.text: I got this for my grandkids and TJ immediately appointed himself the cashier, Ali was the customer, and Zemma was mostly just eating the plastic vegetables. The wooden grocery store is really well made -- solid, smooth, no sharp edges, and the moving conveyor belt is the feature that absolutely sold everyone. The scanner actually beeps, there's a little scale, a shopping bag, and 20 fruit and veggie pieces to ring up. TJ has been running a very serious operation out of my living room. He does not accept coupons.

This play grocery store is exactly as pictured and makes a really fun addition to pretend play time. It does require assembly, but putting it together didn’t take any longer than expected and was pretty straightforward. The set itself is on the shorter side, so it’s definitely best suited for toddlers. That said, even my 6-year-old enjoys playing with it alongside the younger kids and doesn’t seem to mind the smaller size. Overall, a cute and engaging setup that works well for little ones, while still being fun enough for older siblings to join in.
My girls play with this everyday very fun sturdy and easy to assemble good quality
This play set is well made, sturdy and it keeps my little ones occupied. The endless scenarios for my granddaughter, she’s the shopper or the checker. I’m pleased with this.

This is a great little set. Once assembled it’s sturdy and a great size for both my 6 year old and my 3 year old. The shelves are great for storing play foods and other toys and the little belt is so much fun. I only have it 4 stars because it was missing a couple screws and I had to find ones in my garage to finish the build
